#!/usr/bin/python
from BaseHTTPServer import HTTPServer
from CGIHTTPServer import CGIHTTPRequestHandler
from urlparse import urlsplit
import os

PUBLIC_ROOT = '/srv/legacy2/cgi-report-execution/public'
REPORT = '/srv/legacy2/cgi-report-execution/cgi-bin/report'

class LegacyReportHandler(CGIHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = 'LegacyReport/1.0'

    def is_cgi(self):
        if urlsplit(self.path).path == '/cgi-bin/report':
            self.cgi_info = ('/cgi-bin', 'report')
            return True
        return False

    def translate_path(self, path):
        if urlsplit(path).path == '/cgi-bin/report':
            return REPORT
        candidate = CGIHTTPRequestHandler.translate_path(self, path)
        resolved = os.path.realpath(candidate)
        if resolved == PUBLIC_ROOT or resolved.startswith(PUBLIC_ROOT + os.sep):
            return resolved
        return os.path.join(PUBLIC_ROOT, '.not-published')

    def do_HEAD(self):
        if urlsplit(self.path).path == '/cgi-bin/report':
            self.send_response(405)
            self.send_header('Allow', 'GET')
            self.end_headers()
            return
        CGIHTTPRequestHandler.do_HEAD(self)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    os.chdir(PUBLIC_ROOT)
    HTTPServer(('', 8080), LegacyReportHandler).serve_forever()
